name: auth.md
html:
auth.md — luiskr.com

Authentication and agent-registration guidance for AI agents and automated clients.

Audience

Agents, crawlers, and other automated systems consuming content from https://luiskr.com.

Step 1 — Discover the protected resource

GET https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

The PRM document (RFC 9728) names https://luiskr.com as the resource and https://accounts.google.com as its authorization server.

Step 2 — Read the authorization-server metadata

GET https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

The metadata carries an agent_auth block describing this service's registration surface:

{
  "agent_auth": {
    "skill": "https://luiskr.com/auth.md",
    "register_uri": "https://luiskr.com/auth.md",
    "identity_types_supported": ["anonymous"],
    "anonymous": {
      "credential_types_supported": ["none"],
      "claim_uri": "https://luiskr.com/auth.md"
    }
  }
}

Step 3 — Register (anonymous)

identity_types_supported is anonymous only. For anonymous access there is no registration ceremony and no provisioning endpoint: register_uri resolves to this document and no POST /agent/auth endpoint exists. Fetching any public URL without credentials is the anonymous registration — access is granted immediately, no credential is issued, and none is needed.

  • Pages and the docs portal: /, /docs
  • Machine-readable content: /docs-content/** (JSON), /llms.txt, /ai-catalog.json
  • Discovery metadata: /.well-known/api-catalog, /openapi.json, /sitemap.xml

For access beyond the public endpoints, contact luis.krotz@gmail.com.

Credentials

Not applicable — this site issues and accepts no credentials for public content. Do not send Authorization headers or API keys; they are ignored.

Usage preferences

Content-usage preferences are declared via the Content-Signal response header and /robots.txt (ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=no). Link response headers advertise the machine-readable resources above (RFC 8288 / RFC 9727).
